## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- The reduction is conditional: neither \(\mu_{\mathbb Z}(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v)=\binom{a+b}{a}\) nor the stronger freeness statement is proved; claim-11 confirms this remains conjectural.
- Claim-10 applies only to abstract scalar extension \(J_v\otimes_{\mathbb Z}R\). For nonflat \(R\), identifying it with an ideal inside \(A\otimes_{\mathbb Z}R\), or with a geometrically defined coefficient-\(R\) ideal, requires additional evidence.
- Rank alone is insufficient when \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\) has torsion; claim-8 correctly supplies the necessary generator-number formula.
- The source’s broad assertion that minimal generating-set cardinality is well-defined over an arbitrary coefficient ring is not valid without extra hypotheses; claim-9 correctly prevents that assertion from entering the proof.
